description: This file defines constant values related to the configuration settings for Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) within the Fineract project. It includes string keys for various configuration parameters, such as email and SMS delivery options, token timeouts, and message templates, as well as unmodifiable collections to facilitate handling these parameters.

classes.name: TwoFactorConfigurationConstants
classes.description: A utility class containing constants for Two-Factor Authentication configuration parameters in Fineract.

methods.name: TwoFactorConfigurationConstants
methods.description: Private constructor to prevent instantiation of the class, as it only contains static constants.
